  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is neutral or negative, especially after recent spikes.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude if historical mean reversion is observed in the 7-14 day window.",
    "Apply a lag correction: if true outcome is below forecast, reduce next period’s forecast by 5-10%.",
    "Avoid over-optimism after strong upward sentiment; cap forecast growth at 5% above recent 7-day high.",
    "If sentiment is positive but price declines, apply a 3-5% downward bias to prevent overshoot.",
    "For low volatility periods, increase forecast smoothing to avoid erratic swings.",
    "When sentiment is mixed, use median of recent 5-day true outcomes as baseline for correction."
  ]
